judged_text: The third argument passed to refreshOAuthTokens is credentialId — the credential's database id — where the parameter is userId and every other call site in this diff passes credential.userId. When sharing is enabled the sync request sends calcomUserId=<credential id>, so the parent application resolves the wrong user or none and returns the wrong user's tokens or a 404, breaking Bigin credential sync.

adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/_utils/oauth/refreshOAuthTokens.ts`, the third parameter is explicitly treated as a Cal.com *user id* (`calcomUserId: userId.toString()`). In `packages/app-store/zoho-bigin/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the call passes `credentialId` as that third argument (`refreshOAuthTokens(..., "zoho-bigin", credentialId)`), while other updated call sites pass `credential.userId`. If `credentialId` is the credential record id (as its name strongly suggests), enabling credential sharing would cause the sync request to send `calcomUserId=<credentialId>`, breaking lookup/token refresh for the intended user.
